performance.verdict: Google's $1,074 is confirmed dead weight; Meta alone is keeping CPL alive.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $1,074.05 over 28 days and produced zero conversions — confirmed dead weight, not a pixel gap (calls campaign, no call tracking confirmed).
Meta alone drove all 145 leads at $10.28 CPL (Meta spend $1,490.18 ÷ 145). 28-day blended CPL of $17.68 is artificially inflated by Google waste.
Overdue milestone: Stripe Products QA flagged Done on 2026-07-20 — no completed verification event on record against this task.
3-day signal (Aug 17–19): avg spend $99.47/day, avg leads 7/day — recovering from a near-zero Aug 14–16 trough (avg spend $6.57, avg leads 0.67). Trend is upward but fragile.
GHL shows 130 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, 0 pipeline value — 145 leads arriving but no downstream conversion recorded; likely an intake mapping or stage-progression gap.

suggestions.text: Shift $15/day from Google Ads to Meta — Google produced 0 conversions on $1,074.05; Meta CPL confirmed at $10.28.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads (BWS Search Campaign - Calls) spent $1,074.05 over 28 days and recorded zero conversions; Meta drove all 145 leads at a confirmed CPL of $10.28. Redirect $15/day from Google to Meta daily budget effective immediately. Success check: Meta CPL stays at or below $17.68 (current blended ceiling) and lead volume holds above 7/day over the next 7 days. Re-evaluate Google reallocation in full by 2026-08-27.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL opportunity stage progression — 130 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments signals a pipeline intake or automation mapping break.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 130 opportunities created over 28 days with $0 pipeline value, 0 wins, and 0 appointments — leads are entering but not advancing, pointing to a stage-automation or field-mapping break (possibly linked to the BWS dual-intake path). Ahmed/Ali to trace one live lead through the full pipeline and confirm stage triggers fire correctly. Success check: at least one opportunity advances to a downstream stage with a logged appointment or value by 2026-08-27.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta 3-day recovery (avg 7 leads/day Aug 17–19) — confirm it holds above 7/day before any further scaling.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta leads dropped to near-zero Aug 14–16 (avg 0.67/day) then recovered to 7/day over Aug 17–19. This is a 3-day signal but follows a volatile pattern — do not scale budget further until the recovery holds for a second 3-day window. Re-check on 2026-08-23: if leads average ≥7/day and CPL stays ≤$12, proceed to a +20% Meta budget increase.
